spec.input: current and immediate native-frame neighbours, raw BGR, effective AND nonglare masks
spec.support: full-height recorded sector X strip; common pixels across each pair
spec.base: 1, normalized X, normalized Y, neighbour indicator
spec.extra_terms: step Y>=cut; ribbon abs(Y-cut)<width; illumination adds T*X and T*Y
spec.search: all integer neighbour cuts 1..height-1; current candidate cut fixed
spec.fit: float64 ordinary least squares; full rank; BGR/255; rcond=1e-10
spec.spatial_split: crop-local X modulo 4 == 0 validates; others fit all models on identical pixels
spec.operating_point: both temporal pairs: unique uncensored moving-step training minimum, validation MSE strictly lower than every competitor by 1e-12; all five recorded sectors must pass for candidate support; otherwise UNRESOLVED
spec.geometry: native views if any native view exists; otherwise candidate-center views; no invented sectors
spec.limitations: Region interpretation is a tested hypothesis, not physical proof. Reflections or unmodelled texture can collide; no motion-only authority, new scalar, calibrated confidence or chemical-species output.

interpretation: All candidates abstain. Zero wrong support is not a repair: all seven reviewed targets are lost. Sector-pair support overlaps positives and wrong targets. No operating-point tuning or production adoption.
